title: DeadBundle
description: A small fork that, upon death, turns a blob into a single timed pouch, preserving the familiar vanilla gameplay
body:
**DeadBundle turns all your death drops into a single smart bundle.**

_When a player dies, their entire inventory is packed into a white bundle at the death location. The bundle shows a preview of its contents, has a live removal timer in lore, and handles lava deaths intelligently — netherite gear survives, trash can burn.

Features

Single death bundle – packs all dropped items from a player into one white bundle with item preview instead of a messy pile.
Configurable lifetime & timer – bundle lifetime after first pickup, live HH:MM:SS countdown in lore, configurable update interval.
Smart lava protection – on lava death only lava‑proof items (netherite, ancient debris) are saved in the bundle; others can drop and burn as usual.
Container & hopper protection – death bundles can’t be moved into chests, shulkers, hoppers, etc.; attempts show “too heavy” messages.
Particles & visuals – multiple configurable particle layers (main / secondary / red) around dropped bundles.
Localization (EN / RU) – separate lang/en.yml and lang/ru.yml, all messages fully translatable, language selected in config.yml.
Admin commands – /deadb reload (reload config and lang), /deadb time <value> (set lifetime, e.g. 1h 15m 30s or 900), permission deadbundle.admin.
Config

config.yml – language, lifetime, timer update interval, particles.
lang/en.yml, lang/ru.yml – all messages and “heavy bundle” texts.
